label: Stamping the linearized diode
subgoals: Replace the diode by its companion at the iterate
Write KCL at the node with all currents leaving
Collect the conductances into the matrix entry and the sources into the right-hand side

label: One Newton iterate
subgoals: Compute the diode current, conductance and intercept at the iterate
Solve the linear node equation for the new voltage
Compare the new voltage with the previous one

label: The KCL residual
subgoals: Evaluate every element's true current at the iterate
Sum the currents leaving the node to form the residual
Read the sign of the residual as the direction of the next update
